findings.location: Paragraph: "At the next recess she was blamed for cheating on her flash cards."
findings.source_quote: At the next recess she was blamed for cheating on her flash cards.
findings.suggested_fix: Translate the idiom into a more natural Indonesian schooling term. Replace "kartu kilat" with "kartu latihan" or "kartu soal" (e.g., "dituduh mencontek pada kartu latihannya"). This keeps meaning and reads more idiomatically in Indonesian.
findings.translation_quote: Pada istirahat berikutnya ia dituduh mencontek pada kartu kilatnya.
